author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the swinging beat, high and low, loud and soft, stop and go, and playing together, with a giggly circle game.

classes.title: Round and round we sway
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and sway to its swinging beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a long-short swing that comes again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Hold hands, sway in a little circle, and sink down gently on 'fall down'.
classes.childAction: Sway round and round, then sink down on 'fall down'!
classes.bridge: The beat swings like a rocking boat: long-short, long-short.

intro.caption: Let's go round and round
intro.parentCue: hold hands and sway in a little circle.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the swinging beat, together.

classes.title: Ashes, ashes, tap, tap
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each big swing while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each big swing of the song

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand; tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on each big swing. Ashes, ashes: two taps!
classes.bridge: Each big swing is one step around the ring.

intro.caption: One swing, one tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's knee on each big swing.

games.caption: Ashes, ashes: one, two
games.parentCue: Say 'one, two' softly as you tap

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each big swing.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds, and hear the tune fall down at the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing the tune drop down low, like falling down

classes.parentPrompt: Growl and crouch for the bear; flap your arms and stretch up for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear: tap the left side. Bird: tap the right side.
classes.bridge: Low notes are a heavy bear on the left; high notes are a bird.

intro.caption: The bear lives down low
intro.parentCue: point left for the bear, then right for the bird.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high, low and falling down.

classes.title: Stomping feet, tiptoe feet
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Make big strong arms for loud taps; whisper and tiptoe your fingers for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big stomping taps. Soft: tiny tiptoe taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are big stomping feet; soft taps are tiptoes on the grass.

intro.caption: Big loud taps, tiny soft taps
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, never banging.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Turtle ring, bunny ring
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's back, slowly then quickly, with the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are turtle steps; fast taps are bunny hops around the ring.

intro.caption: Turtle slow, bunny fast
intro.parentCue: slow down if the taps get wild.

games.caption: The bunny goes round
games.parentCue: Same song, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Ring, ring... freeze!
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze with a funny face when the music stops; cheer when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while the music plays. Freeze like a statue when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, we go round the ring; music off, we hold still.

intro.caption: Tap, tap... and freeze!
intro.parentCue: make freezing silly, like a statue.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Guess the ring game
classes.goal: Listen and switch games: bear or bird, loud or soft, slow or fast.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: high or low, loud or soft?

classes.parentPrompt: Pause before each picture and ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Then cheer.
classes.childAction: Guess the game, then tap high, low, loud, soft, slow or fast.
classes.bridge: Every sound wears a costume: bear or bird, loud or soft, turtle or bunny.

intro.caption: What game is it?
intro.parentCue: let your child guess first. Any guess is fine.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling sounds apart and switching games.

classes.title: Hand in hand duet
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays the tune.
classes.bridge: The tune goes round the ring; your beat is the hands holding on.

intro.caption: I play, you tap
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Ring concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from start to end, fall down gently, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song always ends by falling down to a low home note

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play, then sink down gently together on the last note.
classes.childAction: Tap to the very end, fall down gently, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Round and round we go, and at the end we all fall down!

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song together, start to end.
